runtime._comment: 1.6.14: the one Ollama the heads serve, pinned. The official Windows archive (not OllamaSetup.exe): it unpacks beside the old per-user install into install_root\<version>, so the old ollama.exe stays for rollback and the desktop app's updater cannot change the served version. Checked against this SHA-256 (GitHub's asset digest and the release's sha256sum.txt agree) and the Authenticode publisher of ollama.exe before use. Never 'latest'. Downloaded 2026-11-17.
runtime.fix: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19545 (commit 84dc81db1, an ancestor of tag v0.40.15 = 02480ca2a): recurrent (qwen35) and vision GGUF models serve more than one request at a time

server_settings._comment: 1.6.14: what HEAD-OLLAMA writes into the boot wrapper (never OLLAMA_HOST or OLLAMA_MODELS, which stay as provisioned). context_length is the initial diagnostic default; a request's own num_ctx still wins and is recorded. parallel_ladder is per model (Ollama's OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL), not the campaign's worker count; the highest useful level that passed is kept per head. max_queue bounds Ollama's own waiting line (a full queue answers 503 at once, so the Gateway sees it instead of an unmeasured backlog); it adds no capacity. keep_alive keeps models loaded between qualification steps and workflow bursts. Flash attention and the KV-cache type stay at the runtime's defaults (not set) so a later memory optimisation can be attributed on its own.

gateway._comment: Expectations checked against the Gateway release's deployment-manifest.json (0.3.0). The manifest is authoritative for listener, rule, account, folders and commands; these values only let F: refuse a release that does not match the lab.

placement_policy._comment: 1.6.23, sent by APPLY-MODEL-CAPACITY to Gateway 0.4.5+: a model without a current declared or measured limit on a head runs at most this many calls at once there (measured limits win). 2026-11-18: the unmeasured reviewer ran 7-8 at once on 16 GB heads and timed out.

head_capacity._comment: Gateway 0.4.0 per-head capacity (2026-11-12, the lab operator): slots 1 (no head sets OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL); memory_gb = RAM - memory_reserve_gb, or the VRAM on a GPU head

business_services._comment: Capstone's QMS and ERP services, each on its own head (packages\services on the stick). Each listens on the head's lab address and is reachable from the Capstone laptop only. rc.4 stays: rc.5's services differ only in their scripts (no byte-order mark), which the lab already works around, so heads 3 and 4 need no visit.
